title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women from Marche and Emilia-Romagna. Their tributes use only what trusted sources have shared, and we keep their memory in the light with gratitude.

women.name: Gaia Stronati
tribute: Gaia Stronati, 20, was from Castelbellino. She finished an art high school, loved fashion and design, and had begun working as a consultant for energy supply contracts.
Friends and her community remember her as cheerful and liked by everyone, a young woman full of love for life and for her dreams.
